title: Extraction or flourishing, taken down to the team — 'It's not something we do, it's what an organization becomes'
summary: Burton takes the book's choice between extraction and human flourishing, which it puts at the level of the company, and applies it to how a leader treats a team. He was prompted by the winding down of the weekly forum his former team had built its culture around, and says no leader would ever claim not to prioritise culture.
attribution_title: Strategic advisor · former enterprise technology executive
blockquote: Our focus will either be more closely aligned with how much we can extract from the team, or it will be focused on providing an environment where each team member can flourish.
